image_description: A close-up portrait of a tabby cat's head and upper shoulders. The cat has a grey and brown coat with distinct black stripes (mackerel pattern). The face features the characteristic 'M' marking on the forehead, large dark eyes, and long white whiskers. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige gradient. There is text/watermark in the bottom right corner.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a slight 'halo' or smudging effect where the right ear meets the background, suggesting imperfect segmentation or depth-of-field simulation typical of AI generation.

Also, evaluate the text artifact: while it doesn't affect the cat's anatomy, it is a strong indicator of AI generation origin. Ensure the 'M' marking is structurally part of the fur pattern and not just painted on.
